subject: Write scaffold.py with plan/verify subcommands
description: Deterministic script mirroring gate.py's philosophy: `plan` reads KB + request, declares module skeleton and flags/excludes non-domain projects (e.g. ApiServer) citing module-boundary-domain-only; `verify` checks the produced target dir against KB mechanical rules (slnx completeness, csproj settings, Directory.Packages.props, .gitignore).
